verses.raw: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
verses.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

verses.raw: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,<sup foot_note=254780>1</sup> then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.text: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.raw: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
verses.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

verses.raw: Except Iblees;<sup foot_note=254782>1</sup> he refused to be with those who prostrated.
verses.text: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.

verses.raw: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
verses.text: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

verses.raw: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
verses.text: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

verses.raw: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,<sup foot_note=254784>1</sup> for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.text: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it, for indeed, you are expelled.

verses.raw: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.text: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

verses.raw: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

verses.raw: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.text: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

verses.raw: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."

verses.raw: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
verses.text: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all

verses.raw: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

verses.raw: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
verses.text: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

verses.raw: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
verses.text: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

verses.raw: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
verses.text: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
